name: v3.1.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Add an Ignores setting that hides matching lines from the window view by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/306
* Fix the crash on the first logged line of a session by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/308
* Keep a busy system clipboard from crashing the desktop app by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/307
* Offer to install the AppImage's desktop entry by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/309
* Fix the Android pre-14 launch crash and add an Android lint/test CI job by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/311
* Tell the user when settings fail, and refuse to start on unreadable ones by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/310
* Route slf4j into Kermit instead of shipping a second logging backend by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/312
* Add telnet MUD support with ANSI colour and GMCP by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/313
* wlab: shut the client socket down before closing it by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/314
* CI: drop iOS, merge the JVM and Android jobs; fix setup-android in release by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/315
* Ask before sending crash reports, and let users read what was sent by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/316
* Fix two game-window selection crashes (DESKTOP-3T, DESKTOP-40) by @sproctor in https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/pull/317


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/sproctor/warlock3/compare/v3.1.0...v3.1.1
